shortBio.en: Green Day vocals/guitar; East Bay power-chord pop-punk scaled from Kerplunk DIY to Dookie/American Idiot mass.
shortBio.zh: Green Day 人声/吉他；东湾 power-chord 流行朋克，从 Kerplunk DIY 扩到 Dookie/American Idiot 大众体量。

whyHub.en: Writer–frontman constant: three-chord melody and nasal lead define Green Day across punk club and concept-stadium eras.
whyHub.zh: 写手–主唱常量：三和弦旋律与鼻音主唱定义 Green Day，贯穿朋克俱乐部与概念体育场时代。

body.en:
Born 1972. Forms Green Day with Dirnt; Tré Cool locks drums 1990. Dookie (1994) puts Basket Case–style hooks beside grunge on MTV. American Idiot (2004) proves punk concept-album stadium scale without abandoning power-chord verse/chorus.

Hub: vocal/guitar authorship stays fixed while production loudness and stage size change.
body.zh:
1972 年生。与 Dirnt 组建 Green Day；1990 Tré Cool 锁定鼓。Dookie（1994）把 Basket Case 式钩子放进 MTV，与 grunge 并列。American Idiot（2004）证明朋克概念专集可达体育场，且不丢 power-chord 主副歌。

枢纽：人声/吉他作者权固定，制作响度与舞台体量变。

note.en: Founding vocals/guitar through Dookie and American Idiot eras.
note.zh: 创始人声/吉他，贯穿 Dookie 与 American Idiot 时代。
